description: Mark a Task in progress: you are working on it yourself; call it before you change code for the Task. Answers briefly, with where the work stands. Only one Task of a Goal can be in progress at a time; for Tasks in other hands, use set_task_state.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.
